stories.title: UN envoy urges support for Syria recovery, warns of Israeli incursions

en.title: UN envoy urges support for Syria recovery, warns of Israeli incursions
en.summary: A UN Deputy Special Envoy called on the international community to provide financial and practical support for Syria's economic and institutional reconstruction. He also warned that Israeli military operations pose a threat to stability in southern Syria.

stories.title: Tanker struck in the Strait of Hormuz

en.title: Tanker struck in the Strait of Hormuz
en.summary: A tanker transiting through the Strait of Hormuz was hit by an unidentified projectile, causing a small fire and temporary power loss. No casualties were reported and the vessel continued its passage after the fire was extinguished.

en.title: Coalition: 3 Houthi ballistic missiles targeting Khamis Mushait destroyed
en.summary: The Yemeni legitimacy support coalition announced it intercepted and destroyed three ballistic missiles launched by the Houthi militia toward Khamis Mushait in southern Saudi Arabia.

stories.title: Yemen coalition forces intercept 3 Houthi missiles targeting Saudi Arabia

en.title: Yemen coalition forces intercept 3 Houthi missiles targeting Saudi Arabia
en.summary: The coalition supporting Yemen's legitimacy said it intercepted and destroyed three ballistic missiles fired by Houthi forces toward Khamis Mushait in southwestern Saudi Arabia, with reports also indicating four drones were intercepted.

stories.title: التحالف: اعتراض 3 صواريخ باليستية أطلقتها المليشيا الحوثية الإرهابية باتجاه خميس مشيط

en.title: Coalition: 3 ballistic missiles launched by terrorist Houthi militia toward Khamis Mushait intercepted
en.summary: A coalition spokesperson announced the interception and destruction of three ballistic missiles fired by the Houthi militia toward Khamis Mushait in southern Saudi Arabia.

stories.title: Houthi missile intercepted in Khamis Mushait, causes damage to buildings and vehicles

en.title: Houthi missile intercepted in Khamis Mushait, causes damage to buildings and vehicles
en.summary: A ballistic missile fired by the Houthi militia was intercepted over Khamis Mushait in southern Saudi Arabia, with falling debris causing limited damage to buildings and vehicles in the area.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia launches safety investigation into Flydubai emergency landing in Tabuk

en.title: Saudi Arabia launches safety investigation into Flydubai emergency landing in Tabuk
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's National Transport Safety Center opened an investigation into Flydubai flight FZ1073's emergency landing at Tabuk airport. The center dispatched a team to examine circumstances and assess aviation safety aspects in coordination with relevant authorities.

stories.title: ‎US economy adds just 29,000 jobs in September

en.title: US economy adds just 29,000 jobs in September
en.summary: US job growth slowed significantly in September with only 29,000 positions added, falling short of expectations. Economists attribute some of the weakness to seasonal factors related to Labor Day timing, while the unemployment rate rose to 4.1%.

stories.title: ‎OPEC+ postpones production capacity review amid Middle East war

en.title: OPEC+ postpones production capacity review amid Middle East war
en.summary: OPEC+ delayed its scheduled review of member production capacities due to Middle East war disruptions. The assessment deadline was pushed from end-September to mid-November as some countries had not yet submitted required data.

en.title: Expat remittances hit SAR 13.5B in August
en.summary: Expatriate remittances to Saudi Arabia reached SAR 13.5 billion in August 2026, representing 1% year-on-year growth. Through eight months of 2026, total remittances reached approximately SAR 113 billion.

en.title: When the Shock Came
en.summary: An author discusses presenting the 10 x 10 report at the Argaam Summit, addressing concerns about whether the report was overly pessimistic in its stress testing of sectors and economic assumptions during Vision 2030's ten-year milestone.

stories.title: ‎France’s Alstom to supply additional Riyadh Metro trains under €460M deal

en.title: France's Alstom to supply additional Riyadh Metro trains under €460M deal
en.summary: French company Alstom signed a €460 million contract with the Royal Commission for Riyadh City to supply additional driverless trains for lines 3, 4, and 6 of the Riyadh Metro network expansion.
